hardware: MONSTER TULPAR T5 V17.1 / N.1.06 / i7-8750H / GTX1060 / 16GB / 12 logical processors
conditions: Battery, Windows Balanced, one native version at a time, normal desktop activity, no build or stress test during measurement. Same Cooling page and connected controls. 12s initial settling and 5s after restore. Two 30s open intervals and one 30s tray interval per version. Power source checked before each open interval and after each version; power scheme and firmware fan/light-bar state checked unchanged.
process_scope: GUI and inherited children including exited helpers use Windows job accounting. The already-running v0.8.0 read-only observer is counted separately through CPU deltas and sampled memory; it creates no children. No observer remains in the tray. Shared WMI provider, driver/service hosts and benchmark process excluded. Memory is sampled at 1Hz and sums resident working sets; shared pages may count twice. Idle WM_NULL replies are not click latency.

runs.label: baseline-visible-1
runs.scope: Job-assigned app processes and inherited children, including exited helpers, plus specified existing external services via process counter deltas. Children spawned by external services after attachment are not tracked. Shared WMI/driver/service hosts and benchmark process excluded. Memory sampled at 1 Hz; peak job commit excludes external services and is not interval-local. WM_NULL ping is idle message handling, not interaction latency.
